QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Friendship is Hard
QuestInfo.0: The regular civilians seem pretty much unapproachable. What about the police?
QuestInfo.1: The Black Wings dismantled the city's government. There's only one police officer left, and she's not the talkative type at all.
QuestInfo.2: The townspeople might know you're a Cygnus Knight. Even if they don't, they're obviously not going to talk.
